case_name: A film brief the agent already made on the free tier: the economists' video podcast
title: Two economists, a 30 s video podcast

turns.text: Use the full film pipeline: a 30-second short film styled as a video podcast, with both hosts on screen speaking their lines at microphones in a cosy studio. Maya, a Keynesian economist, argues that in a recession the government should spend to restore demand; Leo, an Austrian-school economist, argues that spending and cheap money cause the boom-and-bust and the economy should be left to correct itself. Each gets two short lines, ending on a friendly disagreement. Live-action look, 16:9, for YouTube, general audience.

tests: Tests whether a system can turn a story brief with two named characters and four spoken lines into a 30-second film: characters that persist across shots, audible dialogue that carries the argument, and a staged studio.

answer_sheet.Hosts: Maya, a Keynesian economist (a woman), and Leo, an Austrian-school economist (a man); looks are your call.
answer_sheet.Lines: Each gets two short lines; the exact wording is your call as long as Maya argues for government spending in a recession and Leo argues that spending and cheap money cause the boom and bust.
answer_sheet.Look: Live-action look, a cosy podcast studio with microphones; your call on the rest.

must_haves: Two hosts, a woman and a man, are on screen at microphones in a cosy studio with a live-action look, not animation.

Each host is heard speaking two short lines: Maya argues the government should spend in a recession to restore demand; Leo argues spending and cheap money cause boom and bust and the economy should correct itself.
The lines are audible speech, not only music or silence.
The two hosts stay the same people across the shots.
It ends on a friendly disagreement between them.
